cards.lore: Before she carried a kingdom's downfall on her shoulders, she walked the cobblestone markets with a curious smile and an axe she could barely drag. Wondering why the monarch hoarded the royal flame for ornate swords while starving peasants begged in the gutters, she playfully sparked their woodsman tools with forbidden fire never realizing her reckless generosity had just planted the seeds of the Berserker Cult.

cards.lore: Raiding the Darkmagia archive's lost-and-found, the clone donned a tailored trench coat, punched horn holes into a fedora, and struck the calmest deadpan pose she could muster. She had no interest in solving financial conspiracies—she only wanted to see how red her immortal mother's face could turn before the cheek-pinching began.
